title: currency fields: hide the `scale` designer control and derive the summary footer's fraction digits from `currencyConfig.precision` / ISO minor units (objectstack#19629 ruling B)
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#19629

Filed by the director seat, summon #28 (`session_01GLdRPcbaCBQCTvVmU6YEUY`), as the objectui half of ruling **batch #215 item 1 · letter B** on objectstack-ai/objectstack#19629 (the record is the `Ruling:` comment on that card). Filing gate ③ (a ruled task). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What the ruling decided (spec side, lands first)

`FieldSchema.scale` is retired from the `currency` field type: `@objectstack/spec` refuses `scale` on a field of `type: 'currency'` at parse with a remedy naming `currencyConfig.precision`, and the objectql record validator stops reading `scale` for currency. `currencyConfig.precision` — else the currency's ISO 4217 minor-unit count — is the ONE decimal-places knob for money. ⛔ No alias, ⛔ no grace window.

## What lands here — the consumer aligns to the protocol

1. `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/inspectors/ObjectFieldInspector.tsx:905-910` — the `scale` control is not offered when the field type is `currency` (`isNumeric()` at `:275` currently admits `number | currency | percent`). Premise to verify first: which key the neighbouring `precision` control writes on a currency field (the digit-count `FieldSchema.precision` or `currencyConfig.precision`) — report it, ⛔ do not guess.
2. `packages/plugin-grid/src/useColumnSummary.ts:343` — the currency arm derives fraction digits the way the cell does (`currencyConfig.precision`, else `currencyFractionDigits(currency)`); ⛔ no `?? 0`, ⛔ no `scale` read on a currency column.
3. Pins for both (the control is absent on a currency field; the footer and the cell agree on a currency column with and without `currencyConfig.precision`).

## Unlock

When objectstack ships the spec refusal in a version this repo can pin (pin-lag reading applies: the pinned `@objectstack/spec` must refuse `scale` on currency).

Dedupe: `currency scale designer control` · `useColumnSummary currency scale ?? 0` · `currencyConfig.precision footer` · `objectstack#19629`.
